name: seating-plan
description: Seat guests at tables for a wedding, gala, conference dinner or awards night, and check the chart with a script — every guest seated once, no table over capacity, people who must sit together together, people who must be kept apart apart, wheelchair users at accessible places — drawn as a room plan with names at each table. Use when an organiser asks to "make the seating plan", "who sits where", "seat these 120 guests", "check my table plan", or has a guest list with groups and keep-apart requests.

handoff.when: the seating is settled and the day's timings are next
handoff.purpose: Time the day around the dinner: doors, speeches, courses and the changeovers between them.
handoff.fallback: If run-of-show is absent, list the day's items with a start, end and room each, and check by hand that no room or person is booked twice.

permissions.notes: Reads the seating.json it is given and writes the SVG to the path passed with --svg.

model.rationale: Assigning guests against overlapping rules is bounded judgment; the script decides whether every rule holds.
